title: TRICARE Prime Tier Placement from the DEERS Record
content:
The **TRICARE Prime** tier a beneficiary holds is fixed by the beneficiary's DEERS record (the Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System), never by what the caller says about themselves.

## Rule

1. **Beneficiary category.** The DEERS beneficiary category must be one of the tier's eligible categories (table below).
2. **Residence.** Residence decides between Prime and Prime Remote: a residence service area that is a Prime Service Area admits only the tiers whose residence requirement is inside a Prime Service Area, and a residence outside any Prime Service Area admits only the tiers whose residence requirement is outside a Prime Service Area. A family member qualifies for TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member only while residing with a sponsor who holds TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member.
3. **Sponsor entry group.** For retirees, their family members and survivors the sponsor entry group decides between Group A and Group B: a sponsor whose initial entry date into uniformed service is before 2018-01-01 is Group A, and a sponsor whose initial entry date is on or after 2018-01-01 is Group B.
4. **Survivors.** Survivors of a sponsor who died on active duty are transitional survivors for the transitional survivor period (3 years) and hold TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor; afterwards they take the retiree tier of the sponsor's group.
5. **Active duty service members** are placed in Prime automatically and may not choose another plan.

**Condition:** the beneficiary's DEERS beneficiary category, residence service area and sponsor entry date match the requested Prime tier. An application that fails this match is rejected, and an active enrollment whose DEERS record stops matching any Prime tier is terminated as ineligible on the last day of eligibility DEERS shows. The evidence is the beneficiary's own DEERS record (category, residence service area, sponsor and sponsor's initial entry date) as it stands before the enrollment is recorded or activated.

## Tier table

| Tier | Eligible DEERS beneficiary categories | Residence | Sponsor entry group | Placed by DEERS eligibility alone, without an application | Further entry condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | active duty service member | inside a Prime Service Area | does not change the tier | yes | - |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | active duty service member | outside a Prime Service Area | does not change the tier | yes | - |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | active duty family member | inside a Prime Service Area | does not change the tier | no | - |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | active duty family member | outside a Prime Service Area | does not change the tier | no | the sponsor also holds TRICARE Prime Remote |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | transitional survivor | inside a Prime Service Area | does not change the tier | no | - |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | retired service member, retiree family member, survivor | inside a Prime Service Area | Group A | no | not entitled to Medicare Part A |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | retired service member, retiree family member, survivor | inside a Prime Service Area | Group B | no | not entitled to Medicare Part A |

## Boundary cases on the entry date

| Sponsor's initial entry date | Group |
|---|---|
| 31 December 2017 | Group A (before 2018-01-01) |
| 1 January 2018 | Group B (on or after 2018-01-01) |

## Basis questions

**A retiree's spouse states the sponsor joined in 2019, but DEERS shows 2016. Which group applies?** DEERS governs: an initial entry date in 2016 is before 2018-01-01, so the tier is TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A.

**An active duty family member lives outside any Prime Service Area while the sponsor holds TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member. Does TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member apply?** No: that tier requires residing with a sponsor who holds TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member.
